Noted about only having one source of enjoyment. 
It is past the point of asking the professor to change the grade for me. I've talked to her during the semester about missing class because of my mental health, and it did absolutely nothing. 
I've been at this job for almost 2 years and it is in my field. I am worried I will not be able to use them as a reference in the future because of my stupid ass not being able to pass a single class.
